cohort: The study included 400 schoolchildren aged 5-8 years, with 200 from a rural island (Combu) and 200 from an urban island (Outeiro) in the Brazilian Amazon.
finding: The prevalence of active rhinitis was significantly higher in children living on the urban Outeiro Island (34.5%) compared to those on the rural Combu Island (18.0%), with distinct risk factors identified for each location.
mod_finding: Delivery by caesarean-section was identified as an associated risk factor for rhinitis symptoms on Combu Island (OR 5.2 [95% CI, 1.2-21.9]).
